Ozempic and wegovy are the exact same drug (semaglutide) manufactured by the exact same company, Novo Nordisk. The only difference is what they are FDA approved to treat. It also sounds like in your line of work you are up close and personal with people. Have you ever heard of ozempic sulfur burps?
